runbooks.title: Order API elevated error rate first response
firstChecks: Compare the first abnormal metric timestamp with the latest order-api deployment timestamp.
Inspect dependency timeout trends for inventory reservation and payment authorization calls.
Check whether connection pool saturation or retry amplification appears after the deployment.
Ask the owning team to review the retry and timeout change before considering mitigation.
Capture evidence from metrics, deployment history, and logs before recommending any production change.
escalationNotes: This demo runbook does not authorize automatic rollback or live system changes.
Escalate to the checkout-platform owner if deployment timing and timeout growth remain correlated.
